newsitem.title: USA: Helionetics elects to convert bankruptcy.
newsitem.headline: Helionetics elects to convert bankruptcy.

text.p: Helionetics Inc said on Monday it had elected to convert an involuntary Chapter 7 bankruptcy into a Chapter 11 bankruptcy, giving it an opportunity to submit a plan of reorganization for approval by creditors and the U.S. bankruptcy court in Santa Ana, Calif.
Helionetics said the the Chapter 7 filing was brought against the company by certain creditors earlier this month.
The company's election to convert was filed on Friday, it said.
